table: Table 6a. List of biological header variables (descriptions from Table 6b)
note: How a plankton sample was collected (gear, tow, mesh, volume, preservation, counting), one set per cast; the measurements are Taxa-Records (Table 7a).
csv_field_naming: b_<id>_<name>, e.g. b_21_institutes (used for both counting and voucher institution)
appendix_column: 'App' is the manual appendix naming the header's code list (Appendix 4, p.71); the lists are online. No appendix means a plain value in the stated unit.

1.name: Water volume filtered
1.description: Total volume of water filtered by the sampling gear.

2.name: Sampling duration
2.description: Time over which the sampling gear was towed.

3.name: Mesh size
3.description: Pore size of the sampling device.

4.name: Type of tow
4.description: Towing method used, e.g. horizontal, vertical, oblique.

5.name: Large removed volume
5.description: Minimum volume criterion for removing large plankters. See also code 12.

6.name: Large plankters removed
6.description: Whether large plankters were removed (1) or not removed (2). See codes 5 and 12.

7.name: Gear code
7.description: Type of gear used, e.g. plankton net, bottle, MOCNESS.

8.name: Sampler volume
8.description: Internal volume of the sampling gear, e.g. a Niskin bottle.

9.name: Net mouth area
9.description: Mouth or opening area of the sampling gear. Where only mouth diameter was provided, area was calculated as pi * (0.5 * diameter)^2.

10.name: Preservative
10.description: Type of preservative used for the plankton sample.

11.name: Weight method
11.description: Method used for weighing the plankton sample.

12.name: Large removed length
12.description: Minimum size/length criterion for removing large plankters. See also code 5.

13.name: Count method
13.description: Method used for counting the plankton sample.

14.name: Tow distance
14.description: Distance over which the sampling gear was towed.

15.name: Average towing speed
15.description: Average speed used to tow the sampling gear.

16.name: Sampling start time
16.description: Sampling start time, Greenwich Mean Time.

18.name: Flowmeter type
18.description: Brand and/or model of the flowmeter used.

20.name: Counting institution
20.description: Institution responsible for identifying and counting the taxa-specific sample (b_21_institutes).

21.name: Voucher institution
21.description: Location (institution) of the taxa-specific sample voucher (b_21_institutes; same institute code list as code 20).

22.name: Wire angle start
22.description: Wire angle of the towing apparatus at sampling start.

23.name: Wire angle end
23.description: Wire angle of the towing apparatus at sampling end.

24.name: Depth determination method
24.description: Code indicating that depth was calculated from wire angle and length, or from a PI-specific target depth.

25.name: Volume method
25.description: Method used for measuring the volume of the plankton sample.

30.name: Accession number for the biology
30.description: NCEI dataset identification for the biological component of the current cast (v_1_accession).
